	static final Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);

		boolean insideParenthesis = false;
		boolean lastWasLetter = false;
		
		int longestLength = 0;
		int wordLength = 0;
		
		int wordsInParentheses = 0;
		
		for (int i = 0; i < doc.length(); ++i) {
			if (doc.charAt(i) == '(') {
				insideParenthesis = true;

				wordLength = 0;
			}
			else if (doc.charAt(i) == ')') {

				wordLength = 0;
			}
			else if (Character.isLetter(doc.charAt(i))) {

					wordLength += 1;
					longestLength = Math.max(wordLength, longestLength);
				}
				lastWasLetter = true;
			}
			else {
				lastWasLetter = false;
				wordLength = 0;
			}	
		}
		int[] valuesOfInterest = {longestLength, wordsInParentheses};
		return valuesOfInterest;
	}
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		int stringLength = sc.nextInt();

}
